# Native build patches

FFmpeg 8.1.3 makedef retains its original Derek Buitenhuis copyright and permissive license. The Windows-only patch reads an object response file and passes a response file to lib.exe, avoiding Windows argument-length truncation. It does not change codec code or enable GPL libraries. The builder also records the make depfile overrides and adjusts the generated SLIB_CREATE_DEF_CMD to write the exact OBJS list with GNU make file(). Unmodified source tarballs plus this patch and the exact builder form the supplied corresponding source. Mac builds do not apply this patch.

On Windows the generated RESPONSE_FILES setting is enabled explicitly: configure tests @/dev/null, which is not a Windows MSVC path, although link.exe and lib.exe support ordinary response files. The actual linker receives the generated file rather than an oversized argv.

CTranslate2 4.8.2 retains its upstream MIT license and CPU-submodule notices. The Windows-only Ruy lifetime patch releases each model worker's owned Ruy context before the worker returns. Its helper threads are joined during normal execution, avoiding a join from a Windows DLL thread-local destructor under the loader lock. CPU INT8 kernels and thread counts are unchanged; no contexts or threads are intentionally leaked. The exact patch checksum and modified CPU source archive accompany the Windows build. Mac does not apply this patch. A real-model preflight must complete two alignments, including model teardown, before Windows packaging proceeds; full installed GUI/CLI checks remain required.
